question: Which university is responsible for the Academic module of the IUMS project?
gold_answer: S.N.D.T. Women's University (corrigendum 18-04-2019); earlier Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University, Lonere (12-12-2018)

product.answer: The S.N.D.T. Women's University, Mumbai is responsible for the Academic module of the IUMS project according to the 18-04-2019 GR. The 12-12-2018 GR had assigned Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technology University, Lonere to that module, but the later GR amended it to S.N.D.T. Women's University, Mumbai.
